shared_event_contract.source_event_population: HT lexical occurrences satisfying the already-frozen C0 ROW_FIRST_LEXICAL predicate with match=true
shared_event_contract.physical_object_normalization: strip terminal a/b only when preceded by a digit or >, identical to R7-D0 object_id()

eligibility: event is in the shared row-first population
the immediate sequence item after the lexical event is an exactly parseable positive numeric N on the same unambiguous source row

construct the immediately preceding accounting block by first taking exactly parseable numeric N items before the event on its own row, then walking backward through immediately preceding source rows while each row contains at least one numeric-like N/X item
stop at the first preceding row with zero numeric-like items or at document start
the constructed block contains at least two numeric terms
the constructed block contains no X (numeric-like but not exactly parseable) item
ARITHMETIC_SUMMARY.score: 1 iff the immediate following exact numeric value equals the exact rational sum of every N value in the frozen preceding accounting block; otherwise 0
ARITHMETIC_SUMMARY.arithmetic: fractions.Fraction exact rational arithmetic; no tolerance and no floating comparison
ARITHMETIC_SUMMARY.permutation: within each frozen stratum, uniformly reassign the fixed number of target labels among eligible row-first events; singleton strata remain fixed

eligibility: event is in the shared row-first population
the target/control source row has both an immediately preceding and immediately following source row in the same document
SECTION_BOUNDARY.row_signature: ordered sequence of item kinds only, with lexical identities erased: W=lexical, N=exact numeric, X=numeric-like not exactly parseable
SECTION_BOUNDARY.score: normalized Levenshtein edit distance between the preceding-row W/N/X signature and following-row W/N/X signature, divided by max(signature lengths); score is in [0,1]
SECTION_BOUNDARY.target_row_exclusion: the target/control row itself is not part of the boundary score, preventing KU-RO identity or its own row shape from mechanically creating the discontinuity
null_matching_strata: target-row numeric-exposure bin using N+X count: 0 / 1 / 2+
relative row-position bin: early / middle / late thirds
SECTION_BOUNDARY.permutation: within each frozen stratum, uniformly reassign the fixed number of target labels among eligible row-first events; singleton strata remain fixed

effect_and_robustness.observed_score: mean mechanism score across frozen target events eligible for that mechanism
effect_and_robustness.matched_null_mean: mean target-label score over the 10000 frozen matched permutations
effect_and_robustness.leave_one_physical_object_out: recompute observed-minus-null-mean after excluding each target-bearing physical object; positive-fraction is passed to the preregistered E0 gate
effect_and_robustness.single_object_concentration: target-event fraction belonging to the largest physical object
effect_and_robustness.editorial_robustness: for each editorial-status stratum with preregistered minimum n, require observed-minus-matched-null effect >= 0
